highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 adds async pixel readback, a new Vulkan package, and upstream Skia m151 bug fixes.
highlights_body: This release introduces `RequestReadPixels` for backend-neutral async pixel readback on both `SKImage` and `SKSurface`, ships a new `SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET` NuGet package, expands CI test coverage to Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server containers, and picks up the latest upstream Skia m151 engine fixes.

bullets.lead: Upstream Skia m151 bug fixes merged
bullets.detail: Picks up the latest Chrome/m151 upstream renderer fixes, keeping the bundled engine current with the Skia release track.

bullets.lead: Async pixel readback for SKImage and SKSurface
bullets.detail: New `RequestReadPixels` method provides a backend-neutral async path for reading pixels from both `SKImage` and `SKSurface`, avoiding GPU pipeline stalls on Metal, Vulkan, and other async-capable backends.

bullets.lead: CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak fixed in SKImage.Create failure path
bullets.detail: A native memory allocation made during raster `SKImage` creation was not freed when Skia rejected the image. The leaked buffer is now released correctly.

bullets.lead: String allocation eliminated in GetEncodedText null-terminated path
bullets.detail: The zero-allocation fast path for null-terminated encoded text was inadvertently allocating an intermediate string; that allocation is now avoided.
The uniform name-to-index map is now pre-sized to the known uniform count, eliminating rehash allocations when populating a full uniform set.
A new NuGet package ships the Vulkan backend surface integration built on Silk.NET, with Vulkan test runs enabled on both Android and Linux CI legs.

bullets.lead: Containerized test legs added: Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server
bullets.detail: CI now runs SkiaSharp tests inside Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Nano Server containers, broadening platform coverage for server and container deployments.

bullets.lead: FreeType font support on Nano Server
bullets.detail: Switches to FreeType for font rendering on Nano Server, fixing the long-standing absence of font support in minimal Windows Server container images.
All `.sln` solution files have been replaced with the newer `.slnx` XML format, reducing merge conflicts and improving IDE compatibility.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Nano Server Windows container images, fixing a long-standing gap in headless deployments
